llm.summary: This is a coherent remote OCR skill, but users should treat submitted documents as sensitive because they are processed through AgentPMT and Google Document AI.

dimensions.detail: The skill's OCR, entity extraction, and document-type processors match its stated purpose, including invoices, receipts, IDs, bank statements, and tax forms; those document classes can contain highly sensitive personal or financial data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The main instructions correctly say to provide exactly one of file_urls, file_ids, or content_base64, but later generated sample payloads combine all three, which could cause invalid requests or user confusion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions and schema only, declares no local command runtime, and the optional setup-skill install commands are disclosed and related to AgentPMT setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Remote processing is proportionate for an OCR integration and is disclosed through AgentPMT and Google Document AI references, though privacy and retention implications are not prominently explained.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, destructive action, or credential harvesting behavior is present in the artifacts; credential handling is delegated to separate setup skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selected documents, URLs, or AgentPMT file IDs to a remote OCR service. Avoid or redact passports, driver's licenses, tax forms, bank statements, medical records, and other regulated documents unless you are authorized to process them, and use only one input source per request despite the malformed generated examples.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed: generated MCP/REST examples include multiple input sources despite the validation rule requiring exactly one. This is a documentation/schema quality issue, not evidence of hidden or malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Confirmed in part: the skill sends user-supplied document content or references to AgentPMT/Google Document AI, which is expected for remote OCR and is mentioned in the artifact, but stronger sensitive-data warnings would improve informed use.
[SQP-2] expected: Confirmed: supported document types and use cases include IDs, W-2/W-9 forms, bank statements, and medical records. This is purpose-aligned for OCR but warrants careful user handling.
[SQP-2] expected: Confirmed for schema.md: the schema states Google Document AI processing but does not include a standalone privacy warning. This is under-explained, not purpose-mismatched.
